axiom(s9, works_independently(alliebear)).

axiom(s10, xor(participates_in_conferences(alliebear),delivers_lectures(alliebear))).

axiom(s15, xor(gains_acclaim(alliebear),pursues_phd(alliebear))).

axiom(s16, not(publishes_findings(kyree))).

% If someone has a creative mind, then they can make breakthroughs.
axiom(s17, rule([has_a_creative_mind(X)], makes_breakthroughs(X))).

axiom(s18, rule([earns_recognition(alliebear)], or(publishes_papers(alliebear),receives_awards(alliebear)))).

% If Alliebear either receives awards or delivers lectures (but not both), then she gains acclaim.
axiom(s19, rule([xor(receives_awards(alliebear),delivers_lectures(alliebear))], gains_acclaim(alliebear))).

axiom(s20, rule([dedicated_scientist(margaret)], and(produces_innovative_research(margaret),earns_recognition(margaret)))).
